title: The Long Path
checkpoint: Reception Spring 1, week 3 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds sh, th, ng

pages.text: Pip digs a path. Pip digs a long path.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow dragging his feet through gravel, marking out a straight long path.

pages.text: Moss digs this. Moss digs that.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog digging in short, scattered patches of gravel nearby, not in a line.

pages.text: Moss digs a path. It is a mess.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog standing beside his own wobbly, uneven gravel path.
Pip the sparrow standing beside Moss, both working on the same patch of gravel path together.

pages.text: Moss and Pip dash on the path.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog and Pip the sparrow both moving quickly along the gravel path together.

pages.text: The path is long. The path is not a mess.
pages.illustration: A wide view of the finished gravel path, straight and tidy from end to end.

pages.text: Pip and Moss sit on the path.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and Moss the hedgehog sitting side by side on their finished path, pleased.

pages.text: Moss had fun with Pip on the path.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog and Pip the sparrow sitting together at the end of the finished gravel path.
